# Fixture Ownership

G0.2 fixtures include one valid document for each of the eight core artifact contracts, structured negative mutations for required/extra/enum/action/path/version/revision boundaries, an explicit valid typed-reference bundle, negative reference mutations, and a raw CLI failure document. Tests execute every mutation against the production validator and assert the exact rejection category.

G0.3 adds three committed Store input fixtures plus real temporary-filesystem tests for Run creation/reopen, formal publication, hash/ref/path/symlink rejection, idempotency/conflict, Event/Decision append and unique ids, Evidence raw bytes/stable identity/dedup, receipt identity drift, JSONL corruption, durable checkpoint ordering/divergence, plan lineage, and injected crash boundaries. G0.4 implementation 仍负责 stale-base apply、retry/supersede runtime 和 late-artifact/crash fixtures。Fixtures 不代表 research quality 或 downstream Gate 完成。

`contracts/` 增加一个完整 Planning Context/AI Trigger Source Attestation/Plan/Gap/Coverage/Adaptation bundle、29 个结构化 contract mutations 和 future-declared Artifact publish 负例，覆盖 missing/wrong source ref、source schema/hash/subject/trigger/context revision stale、Run/Plan stale binding、closed tuple、coverage relation、retry boundary、版本选择与真实 schema installation 边界。Store regression 另证明 schema-valid v2 envelope 在 G0.3 v1 publish reference boundary fail closed。所有 mutation 都由 production schema/reference/contract evaluator 执行并断言具体 error code/keyword；fixture 不实现第二套 policy logic，也不代表 G0.4 runtime 或 v2 Store publish 已完成。
